messages:
Sophie (AE): FYI customer (Nexera Health) returned our contract with a handful of redlines and asked for PO+signature routing. Can legal take a look? They want the POC to start next week.
Maria (Legal): Thanks Sophie — can you drop the redline PDF here and list the top 3 clauses they changed? helps prioritize.
Sophie (AE): Uploading link: https://files.internal/nexera/redlines-v2.pdf. Top 3: 1) liability cap bumped to 5x monthly, 2) DPA adds data residency EU-only, 3) SLA uptime targets reduced to 99.5% with credits.
Maria (Legal): Got it. Quick answers: liability cap — we can offer 3x for Dedicated with a written risk acceptance, data residency needs confirmation from infra (Priya), SLA tweak — we prefer 99.9% for enterprise plans, but credits formula can be softened. Any special regulatory notes?
Priya (Security): Data residency: customer requires EU-only processing and no cross-region backups. Our Private VPC option supports that; for Hosted we need a signed DPA + region-locking. Also they asked for SOC2 Type II attestation and KMS w/ customer-managed keys.
Kevin (Finance): Procurement asked for PO wording and billing term: Net30 preferred. They also want a billing contact to appear on the order form. PO# will be supplied later. Any discount approvals needed? Current quote has 20% POC discount.
Anna (SalesOps): I can patch the order form — what's the canonical filename for the signed SOW + order form? I need the final pricing line items to populate the DocuSign envelope.
Sophie (AE): SOW is: SOW-NEXERA-2026-v1.pdf (in the deal folder). Pricing lines: 6 months Dedicated capacity (50k tokens/day), POC discount applied, onboarding fee waived.
Devin (SE): Quick technical note for legal/security: the POC will run on Dedicated GPUs with KV-cache enabled. We need to add a clause that data ingested during POC will be deleted 30 days after termination. Suggest exact language: `All customer-supplied data used for the POC will be deleted from Redwood-managed storage no later than 30 days after POC termination.`
Maria (Legal): Thanks Devin — that deletion clause is good. I'll prepare a redline that: 1) accepts 3x liability cap for Dedicated, 2) adds deletion clause, 3) leaves SLA at 99.9% but proposes prorated credits instead of immediate refunds.
Sophie (AE): Procurement also wants signature routing: initial signature by customer CISO, then CFO. They asked if we can countersign via DocuSign or need physical signature.
Anna (SalesOps): We do e-sign via DocuSign. I'll create envelope routing: signer 1 = Customer CISO, signer 2 = Customer CFO, signer 3 = Redwood (AE then Legal). Any special stakeholders to CC?
Kevin (Finance): Please include billing@redwood.com as recipient for the final executed order form. Also we need the purchase order number on the first page (they'll supply it).
Maria (Legal): I'll attach the drafted redline in this thread by EOD. Sophie, once Anna prepares DocuSign, ping me and I'll be ready to review the envelope and countersign.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope created by Anna (SalesOps): Envelope ID 0d3f4b — routing: CISO > CFO > Sophie (AE) > Maria (Legal). Link: https://docusign.internal/envelope/0d3f4b
Sophie (AE): Great. One blocker: Nexera's procurement asked for a 12-month auto-renew clause removed. They want explicit renewal. Can legal accept manual renew only?
Maria (Legal): We generally prefer auto-renew for hosted subscriptions, but for Dedicated/Private deals we can do explicit renewal. I'll replace the auto-renew clause with a 30-day renewal notice requirement for this deal.
Priya (Security): Final checklist for security questionnaire: SOC2 report (latest), ISO27001 cert (if available), KMS flow diagram, data flow (EU-only) and deletion SLA. I'll send the attachments.
Devin (SE): For onboarding timeline: we can kick off provisioning once DocuSign is executed. ETA: 5 business days for Dedicated stack, 2 additional days for KMS integration.
Anna (SalesOps): DocuSign envelope is in 'Awaiting signatures' state. I've set recipient emails to procurement@nexera.health and security@nxr.com. CC to billing@redwood.com.
Sophie (AE): Thanks team — next actions: Maria will post the redline, Anna will update DocuSign, Priya will confirm EU-only architecture note, Kevin will confirm Net30 and PO placement. I'll keep the customer updated on timing. :thumbsup:
Maria (Legal): Dropping redline: https://files.internal/nexera/ma_redline_v1.docx — major edits highlighted. Review welcome.
Kevin (Finance): Confirmed Net30 is ok. Will accept PO# format `PO-987654` when they send it.
Sophie (AE): Customer replied: "We can provide PO after signatures. Prefer DocuSign if that's easier." They also asked if SLA credits formula can be defined in the order form.
Maria (Legal): I'll add a short SLA credits table to the order form. Anna, please ensure it renders into the final PDF for DocuSign.
Anna (SalesOps): Will do. I've added a placeholder line item for SLA credits. Will update once Maria posts the final redline.
DocuSign Bot: Envelope 0d3f4b: Signed by Customer CISO @ 1769001350. Waiting for Customer CFO.
Sophie (AE): Customer CISO signed — progress! CFO expected tomorrow. Keeping this thread updated.
Priya (Security): I uploaded SOC2 report and KMS diagram here: https://files.internal/nexera/sec-pack.zip. Note: KMS requires customer key provisioning step during onboarding.
Maria (Legal): Final redline committed: accepted deletion clause, liability cap at 3x for Dedicated, removal of auto-renew, SLA at 99.9% with prorated credits. Uploaded final contract: https://files.internal/nexera/EXECUTABLE_CONTRACT.pdf
Anna (SalesOps): Envelope 0d3f4b: Signed by Customer CFO @ 1769001442. Now routing to Sophie (AE) for signature.
Sophie (AE): Signed by me @ 1769001455. Maria, ready for countersign.
Maria (Legal): Countersigned and executed @ 1769001460. Please archive final and trigger provisioning.
Devin (SE): Received executed contract. Starting provisioning and KMS setup — will update infra ticket when done.
Sophie (AE): Deal closed! I'll send a brief handoff to CS and the customer. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
